name: Ricardo Velez
bio:
Ricardo's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly. Originally trained as a mechanical engineer in Medellin, he found himself drawn to the intricate world of racing after volunteering at a local karting track. His meticulous attention to detail and knack for problem-solving quickly caught the eye of a regional racing team, where he honed his skills in quality control. Ricardo's expertise lies in identifying potential mechanical failures before they occur, ensuring that the team's equipment performs optimally under pressure.

He joined Tickford Racing a decade ago, bringing with him a wealth of experience from various racing disciplines. Ricardo believes in a proactive approach to quality control, emphasizing thorough inspections and preventative maintenance. His calm demeanor and willingness to adapt to changing circumstances make him a valuable asset to the team. He has a knack for finding simple solutions to complex problems, often using his engineering background and creative problem-solving abilities to find the best path forward.

What sets Ricardo apart is his unwavering commitment to precision and his deep understanding of the intricate interplay between mechanical components. He's also known for his uncanny ability to predict potential issues based on subtle changes in engine sounds or vibrations, making him an invaluable asset during race weekends.
